snippet.title: Silent Hill: Book of Memories (2012) - PS Vita Longplay | Full Game Walkthrough | No Commentary
snippet.description:
Silent Hill: Book of Memories (2012) - complete PS Vita longplay with no commentary. Explore terrifying nightmare worlds, fight mysterious creatures and uncover the secrets hidden within the mysterious Book of Memories.

In Silent Hill: Book of Memories, the player receives a strange book containing their entire life story. After discovering that the past can be changed by rewriting the book, they become trapped in a series of dark and dangerous nightmare worlds.

This entry combines the Silent Hill universe with dungeon-crawler and action-RPG gameplay. Explore different environments, solve puzzles, collect items, upgrade your character and face creatures inspired by the history of the Silent Hill series.
